privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This notice explains what Skyclause stores, where it is processed and how long it is kept.
privacy.subscriberData: Subscriber forms store your email address, role, selected windows and notice language. We record the consent time, notice version and language.
privacy.guestData: The guest bot check stores a device budget token and a hashed IP address. Guests are not asked for an email address or name.
privacy.processors: Email is sent and received through Resend in Tokyo, Japan (ap-northeast-1). Neon hosts the database in AWS Singapore. Stripe processes payments. Model providers process prompts that contain no personal data. Cloudflare Turnstile checks for bots.
privacy.purpose: We use this information to manage subscriptions and their selected windows, limit guest abuse, process payments, run the service and protect it from bots. We do not put personal data in model prompts.
privacy.regionHeading: Where data is stored and transferred
privacy.region: Service records are stored in Singapore: compute, files, keys and queues run in GCP asia-southeast1, and the database is hosted by Neon in AWS Singapore (ap-southeast-1).
privacy.emailTransfer: Email passes through Tokyo, Japan. Resend holds inbound mail there, and a worker reads it from Resend.
privacy.crossBorder: Data moves across borders when the service and its processors exchange it. We do not promise that data will stay in one country or region.
privacy.rights: You can ask to see, correct, export or delete your personal data. Subscribers use the magic link in their email to view or change their details, export their data or delete their subscription; no account is needed.
privacy.retentionIntro: We delete or de-identify data when the period below ends.

retention.readingsAfter: Deleted when the project is deleted.
retention.busAfter: Kept until segment times are computed, then deleted. Segment times remain.
retention.guestAccountsAfter: Then the account and its data are deleted.
retention.subscribersAfter: Then deleted. A hashed suppression entry remains.
retention.ledgerAfter: Personal fields are pseudonymised when an account or subscriber is deleted.
retention.organisationsAfter: Then purged. Deleted database rows leave the 6-hour restore window.
retention.timetableAfter: NAME, SAMACCOUNTNAME and LECTID are dropped at ingest and never stored.
retention.backupsAfter: The database has a 6-hour restore window.

privacy.breach: We notify the Personal Data Protection Commissioner as soon as practicable and no later than 72 hours after a breach occurs. When a breach causes or is likely to cause significant harm, we notify affected people without unnecessary delay and no later than 7 days after the initial report to the Commissioner.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: Skyclause is a decision-support service. It reports source data and approved calls; it does not make decisions for you.
terms.commonsDetails: For guests and reviewers. 1 shared Bukit Jalil project; guests cannot approve calls and there are no subscribers.
terms.communityDetails: For one club or student group: 1 project, 3 approvers, 150 hosted-model runs a month and 200 subscribers.
terms.teamDetails: For clubs and offices with several sites or both packs: 5 projects, 15 approvers, 1,500 hosted-model runs a month and 2,000 subscribers. Planned from May 2027.
terms.campusPrice: RM 900 a month per campus, billed yearly
terms.campusDetails: For a university office sending lecturer notices: 50 projects, no approver limit, 15,000 hosted-model runs a month and 25,000 subscribers. Planned after May 2027.
terms.betaNote: The beta, until February 2027, collects no payment. No customer-facing service-level agreement or service credits are offered. Availability figures are internal targets. Campus residency and any contractual service level are offered only once verified.
terms.jpsCadence: JPS rain-gauge readings arrive every 5 minutes; Skyclause polls every 5 minutes.
terms.metWarningsCadence: MET warnings are issued when needed; Skyclause polls every 10 minutes.
terms.metForecastCadence: The MET forecast is published daily; Skyclause polls it every 6 hours.
terms.apimsCadence: APIMS publishes hourly readings; Skyclause polls every 15 minutes.
terms.rapidRailCadence: Rapid Rail publishes daily ridership for night D on D+1; Skyclause checks for a new file every 30 minutes after its next scheduled update.
terms.gtfsRtCadence: GTFS Realtime updates every 30 seconds; Skyclause polls every 60 seconds during arrival and exit periods.
terms.gtfsStaticCadence: GTFS Static is polled daily at 04:00 MYT.
terms.listingsCadence: GoLive is polled hourly. Wikipedia revisions are checked daily. Their listings change when the source changes.
terms.cameraCadence: The Camera PWA sends a reading every 10 minutes in daylight.
terms.piCadence: The Pi 5 polls on its configured schedule.
terms.pollTarget: At least 99% of scheduled polls start within 60 seconds of schedule. A poll is stored in the next 15-minute database batch. A page showing a reading refreshes its age at least once a minute. Adapters sharing a data.gov.my API stay within its limit of 4 requests a minute per API.
terms.skyGrades: Sky windows are graded nightly at 23:55 MYT, with a 06:30 MYT catch-up. Eligible windows closed by 23:59 MYT have a grade by 06:45 MYT the next day.
terms.crowdGrades: Crowd nights are graded on D+1 when the Rapid Rail file arrives. Until then, the grade is pending until the file’s next scheduled update.
terms.latencyTargets: Internal targets: a fetched reading reaches a shadow verdict within 16 minutes; a crossing reaches Needs review within 3 minutes at p95; approver alerts and approved notices are handed to their provider within 60 seconds at p95.
terms.availabilityTargets: The internal availability target is 99.5% a month for the app, API and MCP during the beta. Public pages, ICS and embeds have a 99.9% target from May 2027. These are not customer-facing guarantees.
terms.guestWindows: A guest-window title can be up to 60 characters. Its date can be up to 14 days ahead, its duration is at most 12 hours, and the window is deleted 14 days after creation.
terms.guestBudgets: Proposed defaults are 20 runs, 10 evidence requests and 5 active guest windows per device each day, with additional limits per IP and a shared daily Commons model budget.
terms.guestAccounts: Guest accounts without activity are deleted after 30 days. Guest-window drafts are not reviewed or sent.
terms.safety: Skyclause is not a safety or emergency service. In an emergency, call 999.
